requirements.quote:
These
three messages are always sent as the last messages in their
handshake flight.
requirements.condition: Certificate, CertificateVerify, and Finished are present in a handshake flight
requirements.required_behavior: place the authentication messages at the end of that handshake flight
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send an earlier-flight handshake message after the authentication-message block
requirements.why_checkable: The ordering of messages in each handshake flight is observable.

requirements.quote:
The
Finished message is always sent as part of the Authentication Block.
requirements.condition: an endpoint sends its Authentication Block
requirements.required_behavior: include Finished in the Authentication Block
requirements.forbidden_behavior: complete the Authentication Block without Finished
requirements.why_checkable: Handshake traces can assert Finished presence in every Authentication Block.

requirements.quote:
These messages are encrypted under keys derived from the
[sender]_handshake_traffic_secret.
requirements.required_behavior: encrypt Certificate under keys derived from the sender_handshake_traffic_secret
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send Certificate in plaintext or under a different traffic-key generation
requirements.why_checkable: Record protection and selected traffic keys can be observed in an instrumented handshake.

requirements.quote:
These messages are encrypted under keys derived from the
[sender]_handshake_traffic_secret.
requirements.required_behavior: encrypt CertificateVerify under keys derived from the sender_handshake_traffic_secret
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send CertificateVerify in plaintext or under a different traffic-key generation
requirements.why_checkable: Record protection and selected traffic keys can be observed in an instrumented handshake.

requirements.quote:
These messages are encrypted under keys derived from the
[sender]_handshake_traffic_secret.
requirements.condition: an endpoint sends Finished in the Authentication Block
requirements.required_behavior: encrypt Finished under keys derived from the sender_handshake_traffic_secret
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send Finished in plaintext or under a different traffic-key generation
requirements.why_checkable: Record protection and selected traffic keys can be observed in an instrumented handshake.

requirements.quote:
Certificate:  The certificate to be used for authentication, and any
supporting certificates in the chain.
requirements.required_behavior: place the authentication certificate and any included supporting chain certificates in Certificate
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use Certificate to carry unrelated non-certificate authentication material
requirements.why_checkable: The Certificate payload can be decoded and compared with the selected chain.

requirements.quote:
Note that certificate-based
client authentication is not available in PSK handshake flows
(including 0-RTT).
requirements.condition: the connection uses a PSK handshake flow, including 0-RTT
requirements.forbidden_behavior: perform certificate-based client authentication in that handshake flow
requirements.why_checkable: A PSK handshake trace can be checked for client Certificate and CertificateVerify authentication.

requirements.quote:
CertificateVerify:  A signature over the value
Transcript-Hash(Handshake Context, Certificate).
requirements.forbidden_behavior: sign a transcript that omits Certificate or uses a different handshake context
requirements.why_checkable: A known transcript and key allow deterministic verification of the signed input.

requirements.quote:
Finished:  A MAC over the value Transcript-Hash(Handshake Context,
Certificate, CertificateVerify) using a MAC key derived from the
Base Key.
requirements.required_behavior: MAC Transcript-Hash(Handshake Context, Certificate, CertificateVerify) with a MAC key derived from the Base Key
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use a different transcript input or a MAC key not derived from the applicable Base Key
requirements.why_checkable: Known transcript and key-schedule inputs allow recomputation of the Finished MAC.

requirements.quote:
| Server    | ClientHello ... later   | server_handshake_traffic_   |
|           | of EncryptedExtensions/ | secret                      |
|           | CertificateRequest      |                             |
requirements.required_behavior: use the handshake context from ClientHello through the later of EncryptedExtensions and CertificateRequest
requirements.forbidden_behavior: truncate or extend the server authentication handshake context outside the defined endpoint
requirements.why_checkable: The server transcript boundary can be compared with the emitted message sequence.

requirements.quote:
| Server    | ClientHello ... later   | server_handshake_traffic_   |
|           | of EncryptedExtensions/ | secret                      |
|           | CertificateRequest      |                             |
requirements.required_behavior: use server_handshake_traffic_secret as the Base Key
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use another traffic secret as the server authentication Base Key
requirements.why_checkable: Key-schedule instrumentation can identify the Base Key used by the computation.

requirements.quote:
| Client    | ClientHello ... later   | client_handshake_traffic_   |
|           | of server               | secret                      |
|           | Finished/EndOfEarlyData |                             |
requirements.condition: computing client authentication messages in the main handshake
requirements.required_behavior: use the handshake context from ClientHello through the later of server Finished and EndOfEarlyData
requirements.forbidden_behavior: truncate or extend the client authentication handshake context outside the defined endpoint
requirements.why_checkable: The client transcript boundary can be compared with the observed message sequence.

requirements.quote:
| Client    | ClientHello ... later   | client_handshake_traffic_   |
|           | of server               | secret                      |
|           | Finished/EndOfEarlyData |                             |
requirements.condition: computing client authentication messages in the main handshake
requirements.required_behavior: use client_handshake_traffic_secret as the Base Key
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use another traffic secret as the client authentication Base Key
requirements.why_checkable: Key-schedule instrumentation can identify the Base Key used by the computation.

requirements.quote:
| Post-     | ClientHello ... client  | client_application_traffic_ |
| Handshake | Finished +              | secret_N                    |
|           | CertificateRequest      |                             |
requirements.required_behavior: use the handshake context from ClientHello through client Finished, followed by the applicable CertificateRequest
requirements.forbidden_behavior: omit the applicable CertificateRequest or use a different transcript boundary
requirements.why_checkable: The post-handshake transcript inputs can be enumerated from the connection trace.

requirements.quote:
| Post-     | ClientHello ... client  | client_application_traffic_ |
| Handshake | Finished +              | secret_N                    |
|           | CertificateRequest      |                             |
requirements.required_behavior: use client_application_traffic_secret_N as the Base Key
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use a handshake traffic secret or a different application-secret generation
requirements.why_checkable: Key-schedule instrumentation can identify the application-secret generation used.
